description: Appends a prompt-provided workflow, state machine, architecture sketch, or plan to a tldraw board without scanning repository source.

boardName.description: Board name under the target repository boards directory. Defaults to "main".

connections.description: Arrows between steps. If omitted, steps are connected sequentially from left to right.

label.description: Optional label shown on the arrow.

repoPath.description: Absolute or relative path to the repository. Defaults to the MCP server working directory.

steps.description: Ordered steps, states, screens, or architecture nodes to draw.

detail.description: Optional second line of detail shown below the label.

id.description: Stable step id used by connections. If omitted, one is generated from the label.

label.description: Short label shown inside the tldraw step shape.

title.description: Diagram title shown above the generated tldraw shapes.

name: draw_canvas
title: Draw prompt-provided diagram
